Calculate the exact probability using python directly without shell interpolation issues.
```python
p1 = 1 / 3
p2 = (1 / 3) * p1 + (1 / 3) * 1 + (1 / 3) * p1
p3 = (1 / 3) * p2 + (1 / 3) * p1 + (1 / 3) * 1

print(f"p1 = {p1} = 1/3")
print(f"p2 = {p2} = 5/9")
print(f"p3 = {p3} = 17/27")
```
